certifications_partner.text: ational response to the changing needs of the manufacturing sector which is driven by the need to adopt industry 4.0 technologies and practices in the face of both Brexit and global competition challenges. The centre will also provide training through apprenticeships and traineeships for people who are interested in pursuing careers in the advance manufacturing domain. It is envisaged that the centre will become a focal point for the delivery of upskilling and reskilling opportunities for the manufacturing sector. entity_geography.text: Performance Successful performance will be an essential feature of work awarded under the Panel. Poor performance will be identified and raised with panel members and may result in termination of a contract and/or removal from the panel. Evaluation Criteria for Admittance to the Panel Application Requirements The Contracting Authority is using a process similar to the OPEN procedure for the establishment of this panel, therefore, while all interested parties may apply, only those demonstrating that they have the required level of qualifications, experience and technical capacity will have their application considered. In order to demonstrate eligibility, applicants are required to provide the following information: General Information Including the following information: Name of applicant Address Key contact name Key contact email Key contact phone / mobile Website if applicable Other social media platform activities Date of establishment Insurance Requirements Confirmation of insurances in place and commitment to put the following levels in place if successful for the contract: Must provide evidence of this level of cover being in place or a letter from an Insurance company stating that these levels of cover may be put in place if a contract is awarded within one week of the appointment

term_value.text: ead/Coach Functie CRM Senior Architect/Technical Lead/Coach Taakomschrijving De CRM Senior Architect/Technical Lead/Coach neemt de rol van architect, coach en leider op in het development team. Dit houdt hem niet tegen om met een hands-on attitude in de technische details van een project te duiken. Hij/zij staat in voor het leiden, coachen en sturen van het team dat een bepaalde applicatie ontwikkelt. Hij/zij helpt FIT in het maken van strategische keuzes m.b.t. het applicatieplatform. Hij/zij helpt FIT bij het opzetten van de vereiste technische governance- en projectstructuur. Hij/zij zorgt ervoor dat de timing, de standaarden, het budget, de documentatieverplichtingen, de kwaliteit, enz. gerespecteerd worden. Hij/zij ondersteunt de projectleiding bij architecturale beslissingen, planning, risicoanalyse, kwaliteitsbewaking en technische governance. Hij/zij begeleidt configuratie- en implementatieteams en staat, waar nodig, zelf mee in voor configuratie. De projecten zijn meestal nieuwe ontwikkelingsopdrachten of grote onderhoudsopdrachten voor de organisatie. Gewenst opleidingsniveau Licentiaats-/masterniveau of graduaats-/bachelorniveau, met minimaal 3 jaar relevante praktijkervaring als CRM Senior Architect/Technical Lead/Coach. Irish agencies and educational institutions are networked internationally. QQI, for example, is a member of ENQA (The European Association for Quality Assurance in Higher Education) and registered with EQAR (The European Quality Assurance Register for Higher Education - EQAR). Ireland’s NFQ is referenced both to the QF-EHEA (Qualification Frameworks - EHEA) and the EQF (The European Qualifications Framework (EQF) | Europass). The EQF spans all levels of the NFQ whereas QF-EHEA only spans the higher-education levels. Both QQI and providers of education and training programmes in Ireland are subject to the Standards and guidelines for quality assurance in the European Higher Education Area (ESG) for higher education. QQI’s Assessment and Standards document aligns with the first edition of the ESG which was published in 2005. The 2015 version is significantly different from the 2005 version in respect of assessment. Topics related to assessment arise in many of the standards in Part 1 and not only in the standard dealing with teaching, learning and assessment. One difference is that there is a specific reference to upholding academic integrity and vigilance against academic fraud (standard 1.1). The current edition of the ESG is approaching ten years of age, is under review and is due to be replaced in 2027. A consultation draft was published in November 2025. The work ‘draws on the outcomes of the QA-FIT project’. 5.22 External quality assurance of assessment External examining and external authentication and external quality assurance by other agencies and parties have traditionally been key parts of the quality assurance infrastructure for assessment in higher education and further education respectively. For example, with a large proportion of the Irish population entering higher education each year inclusive assessment is now more important than ever. Inclusivity is necessary for validity because if an assessment of an intended learning outcome is not inclusive then failure in the assessment by a learner is not necessarily attributable to their failure to achieve the intended learning outcomes. Inclusive assessment that is aligned to well-crafted intended learning outcomes is an important contributor to the quality of teaching, learning opportunities and assessment. The availability to learners of powerful generative artificial intelligence tools complicates matters by constraining the approaches that can be used for high-stakes summative assessment. This challenges validity more generally and not only inclusivity. While designing for inclusivity (and validity more generally) is to be promoted it may not be possible to foresee all eventualities and therefore reasonable accommodations will need to be made. Inclusive assessment may be perceived to be more resource intensive than assessment that assumes all learners can be assessed in the same way (e.g. by an invigilated, fixed time, in-person written examination). Use of AI in education and vocational training is regarded as ‘high risk’ and among the activities listed under this heading is the following ‘AI systems intended to be used to evaluate learning outcomes, including when those outcomes are used to steer the learning process of natural persons in educational and vocational training institutions at all levels.’ High risk systems, for example, require human oversight (Article 14) and must ‘achieve an appropriate level of accuracy, robustness, and cybersecurity, and that they perform consistently in those respects throughout their lifecycle’ (Article 15). The Guidelines for the Responsible Use of Artificial Intelligence in the Public Service are also relevant. Regarding human oversight they state: All AI tools used in the public service must be part of a process that has human oversight built into it. This may include a human directly overseeing decisions in real time (“human-in-the-loop”), allowing the system to operate autonomously with the ability to be overridden or stopped by a human as needed (“human-on-the-loop”) or at a higher level (“human-in-command”). Oppdragsgiver refunderer ikke kostnader knyttet til utarbeidelse eller innlevering av tilbud. Deltilbud Anskaffelsen er ikke delt i delkontrakter. Det er ikke adgang til deltilbud. Alternative tilbud Det er ikke tillatt å levere alternative tilbud. Parallelle tilbud Det er ikke tillatt å levere parallelle tilbud. Hver leverandør kan ha ett gjeldende tilbud per delkontrakt. Forretningshemmeligheter og sladding Oppdragsgiver behandler innsynsbegjæringer etter offentleglova og forvaltningsloven. entity_geography.text: Performance Successful performance will be an essential feature of work awarded under the Panel. Poor performance will be identified and raised with panel members and may result in termination of a contract and/or removal from the panel. Evaluation Criteria for Admittance to the Panel Application Requirements The Contracting Authority is using a process similar to the OPEN procedure for the establishment of this panel, therefore, while all interested parties may apply, only those demonstrating that they have the required level of qualifications, experience and technical capacity will have their application considered. In order to demonstrate eligibility, applicants are required to provide the following information: General Information Including the following information: Name of applicant Address Key contact name Key contact email Key contact phone / mobile Website if applicable Other social media platform activities Date of establishment Insurance Requirements Confirmation of insurances in place and commitment to put the following levels in place if successful for the contract: Must provide evidence of this level of cover being in place or a letter from an Insurance company stating that these levels of cover may be put in place if a contract is awarded within one week of the appointment

Meath C15 N67E via email to procurement@lmetb.ie with the following subject heading: Application for Panel Membership for the Provision of Suitable Sites for Adventure Trips for LMETB students. Queries All queries regarding this Panel Application should be submitted via www.etenders.gov.ie. Dit houdt hem niet tegen om met een hands-on attitude in de technische details van een project te duiken. Hij/zij staat in voor het leiden, coachen en sturen van het team dat een bepaalde applicatie ontwikkelt. Hij/zij helpt FIT in het maken van strategische keuzes m.b.t. het applicatieplatform. Hij/zij zorgt ervoor dat de timing, de standaarden, het budget, de documentatieverplichtingen, de kwaliteit, enz. gerespecteerd worden. Hij/zij ondersteunt de projectleiding bij architecturale beslissingen, planning, risicoanalyse, kwaliteitsbewaking en technische governance. Hij/zij begeleidt configuratie- en implementatieteams en staat, waar nodig, zelf mee in voor configuratie. De projecten zijn meestal nieuwe ontwikkelingsopdrachten of grote onderhoudsopdrachten voor de organisatie. Gewenst opleidingsniveau Licentiaats-/masterniveau of graduaats-/bachelorniveau, met minimaal 3 jaar relevante praktijkervaring als CRM Senior Architect/Technical Lead/Coach. Irish agencies and educational institutions are networked internationally. QQI, for example, is a member of ENQA (The European Association for Quality Assurance in Higher Education) and registered with EQAR (The European Quality Assurance Register for Higher Education - EQAR). Ireland’s NFQ is referenced both to the QF-EHEA (Qualification Frameworks - EHEA) and the EQF (The European Qualifications Framework (EQF) | Europass). The EQF spans all levels of the NFQ whereas QF-EHEA only spans the higher-education levels. Both QQI and providers of education and training programmes in Ireland are subject to the Standards and guidelines for quality assurance in the European Higher Education Area (ESG) for higher education. the context of RPL is in scope. 5.21 Revision of ESG due in 2027 The second edition of the Standards and Guidelines for Quality Assurance in the European Higher Education Area (ESG), published in 2015, contains guidance on teaching, learning and assessment. QQI’s Assessment and Standards document aligns with the first edition of the ESG which was published in 2005. The 2015 version is significantly different from the 2005 version in respect of assessment. Topics related to assessment arise in many of the standards in Part 1 and not only in the standard dealing with teaching, learning and assessment. One difference is that there is a specific reference to upholding academic integrity and vigilance against academic fraud (standard 1.1). The current edition of the ESG is approaching ten years of age, is under review and is due to be replaced in 2027. A consultation draft was published in November 2025. The work ‘draws on the outcomes of the QA-FIT project’. 5.22 External quality assurance of assessment External examining and external authentication and external quality assurance by other agencies and parties have traditionally been key parts of the quality assurance infrastructure for assessment in higher education and further education respectively. For example, with a large proportion of the Irish population entering higher education each year inclusive assessment is now more important than ever. Inclusivity is necessary for validity because if an assessment of an intended learning outcome is not inclusive then failure in the assessment by a learner is not necessarily attributable to their failure to achieve the intended learning outcomes. Inclusive assessment that is aligned to well-crafted intended learning outcomes is an important contributor to the quality of teaching, learning opportunities and assessment. The availability to learners of powerful generative artificial intelligence tools complicates matters by constraining the approaches that can be used for high-stakes summative assessment. This challenges validity more generally and not only inclusivity. While designing for inclusivity (and validity more generally) is to be promoted it may not be possible to foresee all eventualities and therefore reasonable accommodations will need to be made. Inclusive assessment may be perceived to be more resource intensive than assessment that assumes all learners can be assessed in the same way (e.g. by an invigilated, fixed time, in-person written examination). Use of AI in education and vocational training is regarded as ‘high risk’ and among the activities listed under this heading is the following ‘AI systems intended to be used to evaluate learning outcomes, including when those outcomes are used to steer the learning process of natural persons in educational and vocational training institutions at all levels.’ High risk systems, for example, require human oversight (Article 14) and must ‘achieve an appropriate level of accuracy, robustness, and cybersecurity, and that they perform consistently in those respects throughout their lifecycle’ (Article 15). The Guidelines for the Responsible Use of Artificial Intelligence in the Public Service are also relevant. Regarding human oversight they state: All AI tools used in the public service must be part of a process that has human oversight built into it. This may include a human directly overseeing decisions in real time (“human-in-the-loop”), allowing the system to operate autonomously with the ability to be overridden or stopped by a human as needed (“human-on-the-loop”) or at a higher level (“human-in-command”). Oppdragsgiver refunderer ikke kostnader knyttet til utarbeidelse eller innlevering av tilbud. Deltilbud Anskaffelsen er ikke delt i delkontrakter. Det er ikke adgang til deltilbud. Alternative tilbud Det er ikke tillatt å levere alternative tilbud. Parallelle tilbud Det er ikke tillatt å levere parallelle tilbud. Hver leverandør kan ha ett gjeldende tilbud per delkontrakt. Forretningshemmeligheter og sladding Oppdragsgiver behandler innsynsbegjæringer etter offentleglova og forvaltningsloven.
